newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil industry employment falls 0.9 pct - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil industry employment falls 0.9 pct - IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian August industrial employment fell 0.9 percent from July and 9.6 percent compared with August 1995, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
Industrial employment fell 12.2 percent in the first eight months of this year and 10.6 percent in the last 12 months, the IBGE said in a statement.
The IBGE said August employment levels declined most in Sao Paulo state at 1.2 percent, while in the Northeast industrial employment increased 0.6 percent.
The largest employment losses were in the tobacco, diversified and rubber sectors, the IBGE said.
Total salaries paid decreased for the third consecutive month, falling 0.5 percent from July and 8 percent in comparison with August 1995, the IBGE said.
The total number of hours paid increased 1.8 percent between June and July, but decreased 10.2 percent in comparison with July 1995, the IBGE said.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
